FIELDS.FEIN OR SOC SEC #: REJECTED DUE TO RESTRICTION ON COOKING EQUIPMENT.
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: No open flame cooking or use of commercial-grade cooking equipment is permitted.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At The Gourmet Deli, we specialize in crafting delicious, made-to-order sandwiches and gourmet deli items using only pre-prepared ingredients. Our operations focus on food assembly rather than cooking; thus, we utilize only household-type appliances such as microwave ovens and toasters to ensure a safe food preparation environment. We are located in a vibrant, urban setting with easy access for our customers, and we prioritize sourcing all our ingredients from licensed and reputable vendors to guarantee quality and safety. Our team is trained in food safety protocols to minimize the risk of foodborne illness, and we strictly comply with all local health department regulations. To maintain a low-risk profile, we do not offer on-premises catering or serve alcoholic beverages. Our approach reflects a commitment to providing high-quality deli products while fostering a safe and compliant operational environment.

FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – The Gourmet Deli does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Their operations focus solely on assembling pre-prepared food items, adhering to safety and compliance protocols.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – The Gourmet Deli does not sponsor athletic teams as our focus is solely on food assembly and compliance with safety standards.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this helps manage potential risks. Typically, the business owner or designated staff check these certificates to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any crime related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. They have a commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant operational environment.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – The Gourmet Deli has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. They maintain compliance with operational guidelines and have no reported issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – The Gourmet Deli does not lease employees to or from other employers as our operations focus solely on food assembly without the need for employee leasing arrangements.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – The Gourmet Deli does not carry Workers Compensation coverage as it operates under specific restrictions that prohibit the use of commercial-grade cooking equipment, aligning with its focus on food assembly using household-type appliances.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – The Gourmet Deli does not own or operate any other businesses. Their operations are solely focused on the delicatessen and sandwich shop services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – The Gourmet Deli does not have any other insurance with this company, as it operates strictly under the guidelines preventing the use of commercial-grade cooking equipment. Consequently, there are no relevant policies to list.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – The Gourmet Deli is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products, as operations focus solely on assembling pre-prepared food items. This ensures compliance with restrictions regarding cooking equipment and associated risks.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – The Gourmet Deli does not rent or loan equipment to others, as this practice is restricted to minimize liability risks associated with equipment usage.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, as indicated in their financial disclosures. They maintain a clean financial history, which aligns with their operational commitments.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – The Gourmet Deli does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as it operates solely with household-type appliances for food assembly, adhering to all safety protocols.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – The Gourmet Deli does not have any catastrophe exposure as it strictly adheres to restrictions on cooking methods and employs only household-type appliances for food assembly. This operational model minimizes risks associated with fire and liability.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – The Gourmet Deli has had no past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Their focus is on compliance and safety in food assembly operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – The Gourmet Deli has no uncorrected fire code violations, as they strictly adhere to safety protocols and regulations for operating without commercial-grade cooking equipment. They utilize only household-type appliances for food preparation.
